name: lanework
description: Agent skills for Lanework boards: what a board is and how to found one, sweeping and working a pipeline board, a standing watch on a board, running discovery on a project's problem and domain space, producing ADRs and PDRs, multi-session planning that charts an idea's open decisions as tickets and resolves them one per session, and converting Trello and Obsidian Kanban boards to Lanework CSV for import.
